name: handboard pinch
description: A hang from a pinch hold on a hangboard, gripped between the thumb and fingers. It builds pinch and thumb strength for climbing.
instructions: Choose a pinch hold on the board with vertical sides.
Put your thumb on one side and your fingers on the other, then squeeze.
Step off and hang with straight arms and your shoulders engaged.
Hold for 5-10 seconds without letting your thumb slip.
Step down and rest fully between hangs.
